senses.gloss:
Āśleṣā
(‘the embracer’)
------------------------------------------
Āśleṣā is the ninth नक्षत्र (constellation of स्तर्स्) in the list of 27 normally found in Hindu astronomical works. The स्तर्स् of this group are eta, sigma, delta, epsilon, rho and zeta Hydrae.
It is usually classified as belonging to the rākṣasa group. Serpent is its presid-ing deity. It is considered as an evil नक्षत्र so much so that if children are born in it, special शान्तिस् or propitiatory rites like ‘gomukha-prasava-śānti’ are prescribed to be performed to ward off its effects. Travelling is forbidden when this नक्षत्र is in the ascendant.
